install_tell: docker run redpandadata/redpanda:latest — kafka_enable_authorization defaults false in OSS; Redpanda Console bundled with no auth unless SSO/basic-auth configured
misconfig_patterns: kafka_enable_authorization=false (shipped default) with Admin API 9644 reachable
Redpanda Console on 8080 with no SSO/basic-auth block configured

response_markers: Redpanda version string in ApiVersionsResponse software field
active_probe.false_positive_check: Kafka-wire-compatible ApiVersionsResponse must self-identify software as Redpanda, not vanilla Kafka

deployment_tells: Kafka-wire-compatible on 9092 — same ApiVersionsRequest fingerprint as vanilla Kafka works, version string disambiguates
pivot_paths: unauth 9092 -> full topic read/write (same class as Kafka broker)
unauth Console 8080 -> browse topic contents/consumer groups

Kafka-wire-compatible broker port (9092) inherits the same Shodan-HTML-dark-by-construction problem as vanilla Kafka (confirmed via live test on kafka-broker entry) — route broker discovery to Censys/active-probe; only Redpanda Console (HTML title) is a plausible Shodan dork target.
